# Lorenzo De Francesco - Full Profile

> CTO, tech speaker, and community organizer with 10+ years of experience in fintech, cloud architecture, and enterprise software development. Currently leading technology at Azimut Marketplace.

## Personal Info

- **Name:** Lorenzo De Francesco

---

## Bio

Lorenzo De Francesco is a CTO with a clear mission: transform IT from a cost center into a strategic asset. At Azimut Marketplace, he reduced infrastructure costs by over 70% while building a robust, scalable architecture that serves multiple countries. His approach combines technical depth with business acumen — he doesn't just write code, he builds teams, defines processes, and creates a culture where engineering excellence drives business results. Before stepping into management, he spent years as a hands-on developer and architect, giving him the foundation to make informed decisions and mentor the next generation of tech leaders.

He is one of the organizers of the Google Developer Group Milano and Scientific Coordinator of the Master in Full Stack Development & AI at start2impact.

---

## Career

### CTO — Azimut Marketplace (May 2022 – Present)
Milan, Italy. Reduced cost of IT infrastructure by more than 70% while creating a robust, flexible and secure IT Architecture.

### Architect & Team Leader Frontend — Fabrik (November 2020 – May 2022)
Milan, Italy. Frontend Team Leader overseeing a team of 5 members, mentor to junior developers. Defined and maintained the foundational React architecture and common component libraries.

### Senior Software Developer — Costa Crociere (August 2018 – October 2020)
Genova, Italy. Specialized in real-time web applications for the maritime industry. Worked on budget optimization with CI/CD pipelines to deploy applications on ships.

### Project Manager & Developer — CryptoForecast (July 2018 – May 2020)
Remote. Development of the Cryptoforecast platform (application, backoffice, and web jobs). Financial Forecast Algorithms Developer and Project Manager.

### ILS and Maintenance Engineer — Delfi/Fincantieri (January 2017 – August 2018)
La Spezia, Italy. Integrated Logistic Support Technical Writer for the Italian Navy. Supplier management, spare parts identification, and writing maintenance manuals for complex systems.

### Co-Founder & CEO — Navium (January 2015 – December 2016)
Trieste, Italy. Co-founder of a startup developing decision support products for the cruise shipping market. Funded by POR-FESR 2020 Program (€300k).

## Open Source Projects

### MFE Orchestrator
Like Kubernetes, but for frontend. A centralized multi-cloud platform for managing and orchestrating microfrontends across multiple environments. Ship and manage microfrontends in minutes, not hours.
- Multi-environment (DEV, UAT, PROD)
- Multi-cloud (AWS, Azure, GCP)
- Canary deployments, CI/CD integration
- Version management & rollback
- Website: https://mfe-orchestrator.dev/
- GitHub: https://github.com/mfe-orchestrator

### Swagger Aggregator
A Kubernetes-native service that automatically discovers Ingress resources, retrieves associated services and pods, and aggregates their Swagger API definitions into a unified interface.
- Auto-discovery of Ingress resources
- Active pod validation
- Swagger definition merging, Redis caching
- Helm chart deployment
- GitHub: https://github.com/Lory1990/swagger-aggregator

## Client & Side Projects

### Tryvium
Crypto-friendly booking platform. Online booking for hotels and accommodations with crypto payments. Role: Head of Frontend Development. Stack: React, Web3, CSS. Website: https://tryvium.io

### Tongy
Platform to teach English to babies through fun interactive activities and native speaker lessons. Role: Full Stack Developer. Stack: AWS, React, Docker, Node. Website: https://tongy.it

### Autoconnexa
InsurTech platform with mileage-based car insurance and vehicle tracking. Role: Team Leader. Stack: AWS, React, Docker, Node, Stripe. Website: https://autoconnexa.it

### Spire Energia
Platform to monitor building energy consumption for condominium administrators. Role: Full Stack Developer. Stack: VPS, Node, Stripe. Website: https://spire-energia.com

### Newo
Fintech web application for invoice advance, allowing businesses to get cash on outstanding invoices. Role: Head of development. Stack: AWS, Docker, Kubernetes, Node, React, Stripe. Website: https://newopay.it

### Duck Internship
Internship marketplace connecting graduates with practical work experience. Role: Full Stack Developer. Stack: VPS, Node, React. Website: https://duckinternship.com

### The Personal Trainer
PWA fitness tracker for personal trainers and athletes. Role: Head of development. Stack: VPS, Docker, Node, React.

### Comunicazione per PT
Personal trainer online video portal with YouTube integration and PayPal payments. Role: Head of development. Stack: VPS, Docker, Node, React.

### CryptoForecast
Platform to predict cryptocurrency prices, centralizing all useful trader information. Role: Head of development. Stack: VPS, Node, React, PHP.

### Navium
Marine tech startup specialized in damaged stability prediction and naval design software. Role: Head of development. Stack: Java.
